context: CLI: todo finding create|list|show|candidates|dismiss|triage|link|promote|sync. create prints the review-protocol §2 defect-gate question and requires --gate class-not-instance attestation; refuses finding_kind bug-class without --fixed-by <ref> (mechanizes §2:63-73: bug-class requires an already-landed fix). create writes the DRAFT FILE only, never the DB — capture and landing are always two steps (protocol compliance). sync walks ~/.benchbox/finding-drafts/, validates via the phase-1 validator, inserts-if-absent by filename-stem id; same-id/different-content is a LOUD ERROR, never a merge; synced drafts renamed *.synced, pruned after 30 days; without write creds degrades to a clear 'N drafts pending' message. candidates orders by disposition then age (the proven sweep order, sweep_blind_spots.py:206-211); --rank urgency is opt-in and only meaningful after triage populates the fields. triage sets disposition/urgency/breadth/confidence/reconsider_after; actionable and dismissed require --reason. promote validates payload work units + verifications, then ONE _write_txn: create_from_payload -> finding_links(kind=promoted-to) insert -> disposition flip via conditional UPDATE WHERE disposition IN (open,actionable) (double-promote guard). Many-to-one and one-to-many via repeated link calls.
description: The findings domain lands in the shared tracker DB as a sibling module (_project/scripts/todo_findings.py imported by todo_db.py — keeps the 2,781-line monolith from growing; todo_db.py is NOT CODEOWNERS/soundness-gated, so the real risk is the manual-only hosted acceptance, which is a gate of this phase). Schema migration SCHEMA_VERSION 2->3, additive: findings (id=filename-stem regex-enforced, date, finding_kind, review_context, observed_sha, verbatim body columns title/finding_text/why_matters/next_steps, disposition CHECK IN (open,actionable,actioned,dismissed,promoted) DEFAULT open, disposition_reason with CHECK required for actionable/dismissed, nullable urgency/breadth/confidence/reconsider_after, created_at, imported_from); finding_evidence (path, pattern, line_start/line_end optional, note); finding_links (kind CHECK IN (promoted-to,informs,resolved-by,related-finding,duplicate-of,supersedes), exactly-one-target CHECK across target_item/target_finding); finding_events (log_event conventions, separate table — do NOT loosen events.item_id FK to items). Findings are non-claimable STRUCTURALLY: no query in ready_items, claim_item, lint, stats open-counts, deps, or batch touches these tables — pinned by a dedicated test suite. Entity shape and promote mechanics deliberately mirror deferrals (open->promoted|dismissed, reason-required dismiss, conditional-UPDATE single-txn promote per promote_deferral todo_db.py:1339-1391).

anti_patterns.dont: Auto-merge draft conflicts or last-write-wins on sync
anti_patterns.instead: Loud error naming both versions; human resolves
anti_patterns.why: Silent data loss in an audit-trail domain

anti_patterns.instead: Disposition then age by default; --rank urgency opt-in post-triage
anti_patterns.why: Capture-time fields are optional and often absent; ranking fabricated or missing values launders guesses into a deterministic-looking order

anti_patterns.dont: Grow todo_db.py with the findings implementation inline
anti_patterns.instead: Sibling module todo_findings.py; todo_db.py only wires parsers/dispatch
anti_patterns.why: 2,781-line single file; hosted write paths are only manually acceptance-tested — blast radius review demands separation

anti_patterns.dont: Store findings as rows in items (blocked, zero-unit, or otherwise)
anti_patterns.instead: Separate tables; non-claimability by structural absence, pinned by tests
anti_patterns.why: claim_item never checks blocked_reason (todo_db.py:1194) so any items encoding is claimable; completion gates are vacuous with zero units

preserves.behavior: DSN redaction (_redacted) on every new error path; tokens never echoed
Deferrals subsystem untouched (findings mirror it, not replace it)
Draft capture continues to work with zero credentials (sync is the only credentialed step)
events.item_id FK to items stays strict — finding events go to finding_events
ready_items/claim_item/lint/stats/deps/batch semantics for items — byte-identical SQL for ready and claim

prior_art.concept: promote_deferral: conditional-UPDATE single-txn promotion of a non-claimable entity into a planning item — finding promote reuses the exact pattern wrapping create_from_payload
deferrals: open->promoted|dismissed lifecycle, reason-required dismiss — findings are free-standing deferrals with evidence + links
events table + log_event — same conventions, separate finding_events table
fail-closed mutation classifier — classify every finding subcommand explicitly

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts -k 'finding and (claim or ready or lint or stats)' -q

verifications.description: Promote rollback leaves no orphan on payload failure

verifications.expected: w8 evidence lists each write path exercised against benchbox-todo
